summary: First testing pass on Placemint. Full backend regression (17 pytest cases) covering auth, companies, pricing, mock payments, dashboard, OA start+submit+review, interview and final report — all PASSED against the public URL. Frontend smoke tests via Playwright confirmed landing page (nav-logo, hero, 14 company cards, 5 pricing plans, microsoft-swe 'not confirmed' badge), password login → /dashboard redirect, company detail page (Deloitte USI, start-oa button), and /pricing page (5 plans with select buttons) all render correctly. Did NOT run the full end-to-end OA UI flow because AI question generation is 30-90s per section (already validated via backend tests). Google OAuth link/button verified — implemented as a button with onClick redirecting to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/dashboard (via window.location.href in Login.jsx line 12), so it does not expose an `href` attribute; behaviour is correct even though the review-request said 'verify href'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1100 lines — consider splitting into routers/ (auth, oa, interview, payments, resume) for maintainability.

OA quota is incremented at start of /oa/start (users.$inc runs_used +1) BEFORE full section generation succeeds — if AI generation fails halfway, the user still loses a run. Consider incrementing only after attempt is inserted (current order actually inserts attempt first, then increments — good — but if any earlier _generate_section_questions call throws, no rollback is needed since insert hasn't happened yet; this is acceptable).

run_code endpoint accepts arbitrary Python code and executes it via subprocess with 5s timeout but no sandbox / no memory limit / no network isolation — acceptable for MVP but flag as security risk before production.

Login.jsx uses a <button> for Google OAuth (not <a href>) — cannot be verified via href attribute in tests; consider using an <a> so the URL is inspectable and works with right-click 'open in new tab'.
get_current_user parses expires_at from a stored ISO string on every request — small perf hit; acceptable.
No rate-limiting on /api/auth/login or /api/auth/signup — brute-force risk before production.
test_credentials: aarav.test@placemint.dev / testpass123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Fresh users also created via /api/auth/signup during tests.
seed_data_creation: Tests create fresh TEST_ users via /api/auth/signup. One user is upgraded to 'basic' plan via mock payment as part of test_mock_payment_flow. No cleanup performed — DB may accumulate test_*@placemint.dev users across runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully working. If retesting frontend end-to-end OA flow, use deloitte-usi and expect 30-90s per section generation. AI grading of essay/coding/interview also takes 20-60s per call. Login/dashboard/company/pricing pages all render fine. Google login is a button, not anchor. Mock Razorpay flow works (auto-verify → plan upgrades in DB). Dashboard body text uses 'runs remaining' phrasing, not 'quota' — adjust text-search assertions accordingly.
